thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: PD #INC-8923 — inference-queue backlog crossing 95% of hotcell capacity. Autoscaler lagging.

pagerduty: PagerDuty ➤ Trigger: INCR_DEPTH_HIGH (severity: high). All on-call notified. Link: https://pd.example/INC-8923

alex_oncall: acked — I'm on it. seeing steady queue growth on cell-us-west-2-hot-7.

luke_sre: looks like autoscaler reconcile time jumped, metric spikes at ~1769912000. KEDA metrics delayed.

jen_infra: confirming node quota in us-west-2 hasn't hit provider soft limits — current spot pool 0/40 available, but warm pools are saturated.

alex_oncall: running manual scale to buy time:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-hotcell-usw2 --replicas=24
# monitor: kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-hotcell-usw2 -o wide
```

alex_oncall: scaled to 24, new pods launching. watching queue drain.

maya_oncall: taking over ops after deploy. alex, please handoff customer comms if anything spikes.

alex_oncall: handing off — brief: autoscaler missed two reconciles due to kube-controller-manager throttling + KEDA polling jitter. manual scale done, blocks routing adjustment ready.

luke_sre: diagnostic snippets:
```
E0912 12:32:14 controller.go:98] reconcile failure: kube api rate limit: 429 Too Many Requests
WARN keda.metrics: polling interval jitter -> 30s/120s mismatch
```

jen_infra: running a targeted provider pool increase (requesting 10 more spot nodes) and bumping API throttling quota with cloud team. submitted ticket #CLOUD-5482. ETA 8m.

maya_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) keep manual replicas until autoscaler healthy, 2) throttle non-critical background jobs, 3) enable traffic shed for free-tier to protect paid customers. implementing step 2 now.

zoe_csm: flagging CSM — working on proactive pings to top 5 affected customers, prepping outage note if backlog persists >15m.

alex_oncall: reaction: :thumbsup: monitoring dashboards — queue depth trending down after scale, token latency still elevated for 60s windows.

incident-bot: Note added to incident timeline: manual-scale performed by alex_oncall at 1769912410.

pagerduty: PD update: INC-8923 escalated to SRE L2 after 3 unacked minutes; acknowledgement by alex_oncall recorded.

luke_sre: next actions: adjust KEDA scaler config to more aggressive polling (15s) and add fallback reconcile loop. I'll open a PR to infra repo with rollout plan.

maya_oncall: I'll stay on for handoff until autoscaler confirms steady state. alex, please file a short post-incident note with timestamps and commands used.

alex_oncall: will do. quick notes for postmortem: root cause likely kube-api throttling causing KEDA misses -> autoscaler starved -> queue backlog -> PD page. mitigations performed: manual scale, provider pool request, throttle low-priority traffic, temporary shed for free-tier.

zoe_csm: sending triage message to affected customers with expected recovery and follow-up timeline.

jen_infra: cloud pool accepted + nodes provisioning. estimated healthy in 6m.

maya_oncall: last check — queue depth at 40% of hotcell capacity, latency improving. keeping this thread open until autoscaler fully catches up.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8923 set to "monitoring" by maya_oncall.

alex_oncall: last: assigning follow-ups: LUKE -> autoscaler KEDA tuning PR; JEN -> cloud quota follow-through; ALEX -> postmortem + customer notes.

maya_oncall: handoff complete. I'll mark myself as responder until autoscaler returns to normal SLOs.

pagerduty: Incident INC-8923 acknowledged and moved to status: monitoring.

alex_oncall: thanks all — good work. :coffee:
